author: @elonmusk (xAI/SpaceX CEO)
text: Grok 4.20 is coming out in 3 or 4 weeks
notes: Implied ~Dec 28 2025 - Jan 4 2026. Slipped: consumer public beta 2026-02-17, API 2026-03-10.

author: @elonmusk (xAI/SpaceX CEO)
text: And the latest Grok 4.20 checkpoints are much better. Largest model variant of 4.20 still hasn't finished training.
notes: Quotes a third-party post about 'Grok 4.20 (Preview)' ranking #2 on ForecastBench, i.e. pre-release checkpoints were being evaluated externally.

author: @elonmusk (xAI/SpaceX CEO)
text: Grok 4.20 is finally out next week. Will be a significant improvement over 4.1.
notes: Reply to @raul_1329. Met: public beta 2026-02-17.

author: @elonmusk (xAI/SpaceX CEO)
text: Grok 4.3 is still an early beta that will improve almost every day, but try it out! We will publish release notes as we fix bugs and add functionality.
notes: Consumer early beta (reported as SuperGrok Heavy only) ahead of API availability announced 2026-05-05.

author: @elonmusk (xAI/SpaceX CEO)
text: Grok 4.4 will be twice the size (1T) with training data through early April. Probably ready for release in early May.
notes: Reply to @techdevnotes. No model named Grok 4.4 has shipped by any official route as of 2026-11-20 (next numbered release was Grok 4.5 on 2026-07-08).

author: @elonmusk (xAI/SpaceX CEO)
text: Grok 4.5 will be 1.5T and hopefully out by late May.
notes: Same post as the Grok 4.4 signal. Slipped: API 2026-07-08.

author: @elonmusk (xAI/SpaceX CEO)
text: Based on strong positive feedback from customers in our beta test program, @spacexai will make Grok 4.5 available to the public tomorrow.
notes: Met: release notes list API availability 2026-07-08 (US date). Also confirms a prior customer beta test program.

author: @elonmusk (xAI/SpaceX CEO)
text: Grok 4.6 in 2 weeks and Grok 4.7 in 4 weeks
notes: Implied ~Aug 7. Grok 4.6 shipped 2026-08-12.

author: @elonmusk (xAI/SpaceX CEO)
text: Grok 4.6 in 2 weeks and Grok 4.7 in 4 weeks
notes: Implied ~Aug 21. Grok 4.7 shipped 2026-09-21 (about a month late).

author: @elonmusk (xAI/SpaceX CEO)
text: Grok 4.6 releases around August 7. This will be the 1.5T model with significantly improved SFT & RL.
notes: Shipped 2026-08-12 (5 days after the stated date).

author: @elonmusk (xAI/SpaceX CEO)
text: Grok 4.7 will be the 2.1T model released a few weeks later.
notes: 'A few weeks' after ~Aug 7. Shipped 2026-09-21.

author: @elonmusk (xAI/SpaceX CEO)
text: Grok 4.7 is significantly better than 4.6 and should be ready in 3 to 4 weeks.
notes: Reply to @beffjezos. Implied Sep 2-9. Shipped 2026-09-21.

author: @elonmusk (xAI/SpaceX CEO)
text: Grok 4.7 comes out in 10 days
notes: Implied ~Sep 12. Shipped 2026-09-21.

author: @elonmusk (xAI/SpaceX CEO)
text: Grok 4.7 needs a few more days to cook.
notes: Reply to @farzyness; acknowledges slip. Shipped 10 days later (2026-09-21).

author: @elonmusk (xAI/SpaceX CEO)
text: Grok 4.7 should be roughly on par with Opus 5.0, not 5.1. Better in some ways, worse in others.
notes: Reply to @itslueul; capability expectation, no date.

author: @elonmusk (xAI/SpaceX CEO)
text: Grok 4.8 will be a noticeable improvement.
notes: Same post; no date given.

author: @elonmusk (xAI/SpaceX CEO)
text: Grok 4.9 is probably Astra/Fable class.
notes: Same post; Grok 4.9 not released or announced by any route as of 2026-11-20.

author: @elonmusk (xAI/SpaceX CEO)
text: Grok 5 maybe better than anything. We shall see.
notes: Same post; no date given.

author: @elonmusk (xAI/SpaceX CEO)
text: Now, 4.8 is in RL and the evals are starting to climb. We will do a soft rollout to Bot users later this week and see how it goes.
notes: Reply to @cradrrat. Musk confirmed on 2026-11-17 that a soft rollout to some Bot users happened.

author: @elonmusk (xAI/SpaceX CEO)
text: Grok 4.8 has not rolled out for general use yet, just some trials behind the scenes
notes: Reply to @Marko_Poly.

author: @elonmusk (xAI/SpaceX CEO)
text: We did do a soft rollout to some Bot users, but still have another week or two of polish before general release
notes: Reply to @IterIntellectus. Implies general release ~Nov 24 - Dec 1 2026 (unresolved at ledger date).

author: xAI (official blog)
text: Looking ahead, Grok 5 is currently in training
notes: Series E funding announcement; no date given.

author: @elonmusk (xAI/SpaceX CEO)
text: But Grok 5 should exceed Opus 5.5 and maybe that happens in 2 or 3 months, with continued acceleration thereafter.
notes: Reply to @Dimdv99. Implies ~Jan-Feb 2027.

author: Meta (AI at Meta blog)
text: We're opening a private API preview to select users.
notes: Muse Spark (1.0) never became a GA public API model; the public Meta Model API opened with Muse Spark 1.1 on 2026-07-09.

author: Meta (AI at Meta blog)
text: With larger models in development, these results demonstrate that our stack is scaling effectively.
notes: Generic roadmap statement; larger models later shipped as Muse Wonder / Muse Wonder Full (2026-10-12).

author: Meta (AI at Meta blog)
text: Muse Video is coming soon to creators and Meta AI.
notes: No date given. Not launched as of 2026-11-20 (~4.5 months later).

author: Meta (research blog)
text: This marks our next step toward the frontier, with larger and much more capable models on the way.
notes: Muse Code / Muse Spark 1.2 launch post; larger models later shipped as Muse Wonder (2026-10-12).

model_ref: open weight version of muse spark 1.2
author: @alexandr_wang (Meta Chief AI Officer, head of Meta Superintelligence Labs)
text: big announcement today: we will be releasing an open weight version of muse spark 1.2 soon.
notes: Fulfilled as Muse Spark Open on 2026-10-15 (~9.5 weeks later).

author: @finkd (Mark Zuckerberg, Meta CEO)
text: Next up 🍉 and Muse Spark open weights releases coming soon.
notes: Muse Spark 1.3 launch post. Open weights shipped 2026-10-15.

author: @finkd (Mark Zuckerberg, Meta CEO)
text: Next up 🍉 and Muse Spark open weights releases coming soon.
notes: Watermelon emoji teaser for an unnamed next release; plausibly Muse Wonder (released 2026-10-12) but Meta has not confirmed the mapping.

model_ref: Muse Realtime Avatar / Muse Realtime Voice
author: Meta (research blog)
text: Today, we're introducing Muse Realtime Avatar, our state-of-the-art embodiment technology that turns Muse Realtime Voice into expressive, interactive avatars.
notes: Previewed at Connect 2026; rollout in the Muse app announced 2026-11-05.

author: Meta (research blog)
text: Muse Wonder will soon power experiences in Muse, and will roll out first to subscribers.
notes: Consumer rollout of Muse Wonder itself not confirmed by 2026-11-20 (on 2026-11-06 Muse/Meta AI moved to specialized models trained using Muse Wonder).

author: @alexandr_wang (Meta Chief AI Officer, head of Meta Superintelligence Labs)
text: many people still sleeping on Muse Wonder Full. all good, we have better models on the way 🔜 👿
notes: No model named; nothing matching shipped by 2026-11-20 other than the smaller Muse Ember (2026-11-09).

author: Meta (research blog)
text: We have even more efficient models in training and look forward to sharing what's next.
notes: Muse Ember launch post.
